subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling from the given options to fill in the blank.

They may vary and seem very different, but they are not _______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**irreconcilable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**irreconcilable**" means impossible to reconcile; incompatible. (मेल न खानेवाला)
 
• Even though they appear very different, the question states they are not impossible to bring into agreement. 
 
• The other options: "**irrecincilable**," "**irrecosilable**," and "**ireconcilable**" are incorrect spellings.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *They may vary and seem very different, but they are not irreconcilable__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Reconcilable (मेल योग्य)**: means able to be made compatible or consistent.
